newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco withdraws 455 mln dirhams at auction.
newsitem.headline: Morocco withdraws 455 mln dirhams at auction.

text.p: Morocco's Bank al-Maghrib (central bank) withdrew 455 million dirhams from the money market for one week at its repurchase auction, the bank said on Thursday.
The bank received bids totalling 4.954 billion dirhams and allocated 2.010 billion dirhams at 6.5 percent interest rate. That was less than the 2.465 billion dirhams leaving the market this week.
The bank satisfied 40.57 percent of the demand for liquidity.
The next auction is due on June 11.
